issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires ExcellenceLand.rides to be a private attribute of type List<Ride> and that public getters exist. In the solution, the rides field is declared public (public List<Ride> rides;). This contradicts the specified visibility and may confuse students about whether the field should be private with a getter or public (accessible directly).
issues.suggested_fix: Make the rides attribute private in the solution (and template) by changing the declaration to 'private List<Ride> rides;'. Keep the existing public getter getRides() to provide access. This aligns the implementation with the problem statement requirement and avoids student confusion.
